verdict.rationale: Gusto documents its own business-formation flow, covering company formation, EIN registration and a business bank account in one guided flow, which addresses the filing portion of the story. However, the only entity type named is an LLC, and the capability is in early beta. Missing for 10: Delaware or C-corp incorporation specifically, bylaws generation, initial board approvals/consents, general availability beyond beta, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the formation flow.

support.subject: As a founder, I can incorporate a Delaware startup end-to-end online, including the filing, bylaws, and initial board approvals

citations.quote: Company formation. Entrepreneurs can form their business directly through Gusto.
helping entrepreneurs form their company, register for an EIN, and open a business bank account in a single guided flow
Owners can now form an LLC, open a business bank account, and see where their money stands in Gusto, before they hire anyone.
These capabilities are in early beta and will roll out to more entrepreneurs in the coming months.
